text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the designation of a school bus loading zone on the west side of Logan Avenue fronting Frankland Community School, located south of Danforth Avenue. The proposed amendment will accommodate pick-up and drop-off activities for students arriving at the school by bus and will require the school's existing short-term parking area be shorted by approximately two spaces. These recommendations are being made in consultation with the Frankland Community School representatives and the Councillor’s office.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing maximum 10-minute parking regulation in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Logan Avenue, between a point 50 metres south of Danforth Avenue and point 38.2 metres further south, to be in effect from between a point 50 metres south of Danforth Avenue and a point 27 metres further south. 2. Designated a school bus loading zone to be in effect from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Logan Avenue, between a point 77 metres south of Danforth Avenue East and point 11.2 metres further south.
